args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 deployed to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west) began failing health checks with an error rate of ~18%. args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 health check failures — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an ~18% error rate. Checking the deployment history, v2.3.0 was the most recent release verified healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: All production regions were rolled back to v2.3.0 (the rollback was permitted since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production, so no change-manager approval was required).

3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all three regions, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 health check failures — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the confirmed recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.
